image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: First Orbit
image:image.image:caption: Planet-Man is introduced as a creator god who can make miniature worlds but quickly loses interest once a new idea appears. Every bead on his bodysuit is another tiny planet, many of them forgotten after their first spark of novelty.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Disastero
image:image.image:caption: Disastero is introduced as a walking apocalypse whose elemental body embodies his power: water head, tidal-wave hair, tornado arms, cracked stone torso, and lava legs.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Scalard
image:image.image:caption: Scalard is introduced as an asymmetrical wizard who sees evil as the true natural order. His split form embodies his philosophy: one face half is red with a black devil horn, the other shimmering white with half of a gold halo, and his...

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Madame Multiverse
image:image.image:caption: Madame Multiverse is introduced as a lonely cosmic god with silver comet-tail hair, nebula-dust skin, radiant blue starburst eyes, and a patchwork dress made from stitched miniature universes.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Dream Reaper
image:image.image:caption: After the destruction of Madame Multiverse's dress, Planet-Man falls asleep in his HQ bedroom and dreams himself into a colorful, glowing realm of exotic miniature planets.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Nothing Much
image:image.image:caption: While Planet-Man is away on another mission, Shrink-Scope has a clairvoyant vision of a bank robbery. She decides not to call Planet-Man because the threat appears small enough for her to handle alone, especially since she has already used...

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Everything Will Be Okay
image:image.image:caption: Shrink-Scope asks Planet-Man if he is happy and whether he resents being kept on her world. Planet-Man reassures her that even though he did not choose to arrive there at first, he has found purpose, community, and a real home.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Machine Monarch
image:image.image:caption: Machine Monarch is already shrunken inside Shrink-Scope's miniature prison. His cell blocks his machine-control power with a jammer, and its reinforced walls prevent brute-force escape. He studies the routines of the prison instead.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Hoppette
image:image.image:caption: Planet-Man and Shrink-Scope return to HQ exhausted, only for Hoppette to hop out of a glowing white lily pad glyph on the floor. They treat her as an intruder.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Blizzard Redesignation
image:image.image:caption: Char Cole, a fire-powered supervillain, brings the defeated ice Golem Guardian Blizzard to Doctor Metal Fist's lab. Blizzard is treated like a specimen while the villains scan him to understand where the new guardians came from.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Lily Pad Lesson
image:image.image:caption: Hoppette invites Shrink-Scope to spar in a combat training room on another miniature planet. Shrink-Scope begins cocky because she has beaten Hoppette before, but Hoppette blinds Shrink-Scope's crystal eyes with mucus, blocks her future...

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Hop Incoming
image:image.image:caption: Hoppette hides by a campfire on a random miniature planet and meets a talking dog who also ran away from home. A red warning announces "Hop Incoming," and Hoppette hides before Bruiser arrives through a lily pad glyph.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Shock Step
image:image.image:caption: Planet-Man chases Shock Step, a blue-lightning speedster who has robbed a jewelry store. Planet-Man is so exhausted that he loses consciousness mid-flight and crashes onto a rooftop while Shock Step escapes taunting him.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Bruiser
image:image.image:caption: Late at night, Hoppette appears in Shrink-Scope's HQ in a panic. Shrink-Scope tries to keep Planet-Man out of the crisis because he needs rest, but Bruiser has already followed Hoppette through the lily pad route.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: Circuit Divinity
image:image.image:caption: In the aftermath of Bruiser's attack, Machine Monarch stands one inch tall on Bruiser's unconscious body while Planet-Man, Shrink-Scope, and Hoppette are also unconscious nearby.

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: All Machines
image:image.image:caption: Leapona wakes on Circuit World after her defeat. Bruiser stands over her, but he no longer behaves like an ally. Machine Monarch climbs onto Bruiser's shoulder and reveals that Bruiser's shattered red cybernetic eye has been replaced with a...

image:image.image:title: Planet-Man: No Thanks To You
image:image.image:caption: After Machine Monarch and Bruiser leave for Circuit World, Shrink-Scope wakes first in the damaged HQ and races to Planet-Man. Hoppette wakes injured nearby and asks if Planet-Man is alive.
